Must visit!
Mar 2024 • Family
Steersman Brewery is a rare brewery/restaurant that offers an exceptional variety of craft beers and craft soda and provides a truly one-of-a-kind dining experience. 

The service here is top-notch! Staff members are attentive and genuinely passionate about making your visit memorable. 

What sets Steersman apart is the personal touch of the owner. Ben, one of the owners, welcomed us with a genuine smile and took the time to discuss the menu, share the stories behind the dishes, and explain the brewery's vision. 

Steersman is a vibe!

Best Hard Sodas in Southeast Asia!
Oct 2023 • Friends
My favorite taproom in HCMC! Whenever I’m looking to entertain friends or colleagues, I usually bring them here for a great night of food and drinks. A very spacious outdoor environment, great tasting food, and the best hard sodas in Vietnam!

If it’s your first time here, I always recommend starting off with the hard mango soda. It’s the introduction to Steerman’s household drink. If your more of a straight beer person, can’t go wrong with the Flying Bees. Still can’t decide? Go with a beer flight and try it all.

They recently refreshed the food menu and the chicken stuffed sticky rice dish is bomb! Overall you can’t really go wrong bringing friends here and having a wonderful night out! Would recommend!

Fun beer garden in the heart of Saigon
Oct 2023 • Friends
Love the vibe that this place has going! Interesting craft beers and hard soda. Actually - it's pretty hard to find good alternatives to beer sometimes so its nice to see something like their hard soda. Our group had several people not interested in beer and they loved the mango and other tropical fruit hard soda options. My favorite beers were the honey ale and hefenweizen. The fusion food paired well with our drinks - we had seabass, dumplings, bbq and other bites. 

Overall it's hip, breezy and a great place to hang out with friends before going out further at night.

Not a real brewpub with cheap service
Oct 2023 • Couples
When we arrived, we asked to sample some of the five or so home brews they have as we were not sure of the flavors. However, they do not provide samples???? This is not the way brew pubs operate for first-time, and now, last-time customers. Next, when they did bring the beer out, we asked for less foam (before they poured), and our glasses came without the foam but also about 2/3 of the glass filled. What? We asked for a complete glass, and they did not complete that request. Finally, we ordered two appetizers which took 30 minutes to prepare (we were the only ones in the restaurant), and the portion sizes were substandard. Needless to stay, we did not stay for dinner. There are much better places in HCMC as we have lived here now for a few years and thought we would try a new place. Very disappointing in many aspects.

Steersman Brewery
Hello Christopher. Thanks for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry we didn’t meet your expectations. We hope to clarify some points:

The flight option allows guests to try different drinks. We do our best to offer samples but unfortunately cannot accommodate when asking for samples of all of our drinks at one time.

Our pint glasses are 570 ml but the menu offering is 500 ml to account for foam, or in some cases, without foam. 

Wedges are part of the side dishes, which are easier to prepare. Wings and other starter items take more time and sometimes may not be served at the same time with sides.

We’re sorry again to disappoint but we hope you’ll give us another chance in the future.

Hidden craft beer restaurant gem in HCM
Aug 2023 • Friends
So glad we found this spot on a random walk from our Airbnb on a Monday night on a quick trip to HCM. A nicely designed open space restaurant with locally-brewed craft beers and hard sodas. All the drinks are very easy to drink, especially the hard sodas and double trouble cocktails that taste amazing but still hit you good later on :D Not to mention the food is surprisingly good as Vietnamese fusion. We went on a Monday where they have 19k oysters, and man they are hugee with amazing sauce and quality. This place is also pet friendly so we saw some very cute dogs.
We also got to meet the owners, who are very passionate and believe in their mission of introducing craft beer to a wider audience. Will definitely return on our next visit to HCM.
